The '''Doshan blood worm''' was a [[Color/Legends|Red]]-colored [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Worm/Legends|worm]] that was considered by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] to be a delicacy.<ref name="The Way of the Jedi" />

{{RPG|''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi]]''}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Bant Eerin's Padawan|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin]] met with the Trandoshan [[War Chief]] [[Raikhssa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] to negotiate permission for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to [[Battle of Akoshissss|attack]] a [[Bitt Panith's secret base|Separatist base]] on the Trandoshan-controlled [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Akoshissss]]. During their meeting, Raikhssa offered the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] a bowl of Doshan [[Blood/Legends|blood]] worms to eat.<ref name="The Way of the Jedi" />
{{Endgame}}
